TO_CHAR( occurred_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) AS "occurredAt",
CASE WHEN expected_clear_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR( expected_clear_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) END AS "expectedClearAt",
